verdict.rationale: Dagster+ is a hosted orchestration platform with APIs and an MCP server, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions API tokens, scopes, roles, or permission-limited credentials. The MCP server item (dagster-docs-14) only describes accessing information and taking actions in a deployment, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
